# Aftergraph

> Infrastructure and open research for verifiable intelligent systems: missions, authority, durable execution, evidence, verification and agentic institutions.

## Key pages

- [aftergraph.org](https://aftergraph.org/): Landing page
- [Launcher](https://aftergraph.org/launch): System launcher / command palette for all Aftergraph destinations
- [Status](https://aftergraph.org/status): Operational snapshot (build-time)
- [Knowledge Plane docs](https://docs.aftergraph.org/): Live developer & research portal
- [Knowledge Plane quickstart](https://docs.aftergraph.org/developers/quickstart/): Verify the plane in 10 minutes
- [Knowledge Plane Contract Explorer](https://docs.aftergraph.org/standards/contracts/): 13 canonical cross-repo contracts
- [Knowledge Plane Evidence](https://docs.aftergraph.org/evidence/claim-graph/): C-001..C-008 claims with verbatim audit statuses
- [Knowledge Plane Sentinel](https://docs.aftergraph.org/sentinel/): Verified code-review strategy docs
- [Health](https://aftergraph.org/healthz): Deployment status

## Evidence rule

Visibility never upgrades evidence. Research claims, experiments, prototypes and production capabilities are labelled by maturity on every surface. Research evidence is never runtime authority by itself.
